# developer.paypal.com documentation — Reports

> 33 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation under Reports. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Reports

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/overview/): Dashboard
- [overview.md](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/overview.md): Reconcile daily payments and fees for all payment activity including sales, refunds, disputes, fees, and withdrawals. Understand payouts to your bank accounts.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/balance): The Balance report helps merchants reconcile payment activity. It contains a list of all payments, disputes, and fee-incurring events.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/settlement): The Settlement report is for merchants and payment processing partners.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/disbursement-reconciliation): The Disbursement Reconciliation Report (DRR) helps you reconcile the payouts that you receive, primarily in your bank account, with the payments, refunds, and other transactions…
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/activity-download): When you need to analyze transaction details, reconcile accounts, or integrate activity data with external systems, you need flexible access to your transaction history.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/transaction-detail): The Transaction Detail report provides merchants and payment processing partners with detailed information about every transaction that occurs in an account, regardless of whether…
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/fees-reports): The fees report provides a transaction-level breakdown of interchange fees, scheme fees, and PayPal fees that are associated with card-processed transactions.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/attempts-declines): The Attempts and Declines report provides insights into payment transactions that were attempted and those that were declined.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/case-report-specification): The Case Report is for merchants that process large payment volumes, which are handled best through programmatic interfaces.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/dispute-detail-custom): The Dispute Detail Custom report provides merchants and processing partners with regular operational information about all claims made against their PayPal account, along with the…
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/monthly-custom-statements): Monthly and custom statements are bank-style reports that help you reconcile your PayPal account with your internal accounting records.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/order): The Order report (ORT) gives merchants and processing partners detailed information about outstanding authorized orders that can be captured.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/preapproved-payments-agreement): The Preapproved Payments Agreements report is for merchants and payment processing partners who have integrated the Preapproved Payments product.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/recurring-payments-profile): The Recurring Payments Profile Report (RPP) is for merchants and payment processing partners who integrate the Recurring Payments product.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/user-audit): DOCS
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/access): PayPal delivers many reports to a secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) environment.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/reference/changed-fields): When PayPal updates the Activity Download report, column names and their possible values can change.
- [balance.md](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/balance.md): Possible values: `UNREGULATED`, `REGULATED`, `REGULATED_WITH_FRAUD`, `NULL`, or `UNKNOWN`.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/reference/supported-currencies): Currency codes appear alongside monetary amounts throughout PayPal reports.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/reports/reference/cryptocurrencies): PayPal reports use cryptocurrency codes to represent digital asset transactions.
